messages:
oliver: quick heads-up — release freeze goes into effect at 10:00 PST (T-2h). If you absolutely need a late merge, fill the late-merge form: https://go/release-exceptions and ping me. Docs-only or changelog-only bumps are the easiest to process but still require the form.

maria: @oliver quick question — PR #6289 is a client version bump + CHANGELOG.md update. No binary changes. Is that considered docs/changelog-only?

aj: FYI #6289 kicked a flaky integration test on main this morning; I can rebase and rerun CI. If it's purely metadata we can label it docs-only and fast-track.

kevin: please add the `cherry-pick-to-release` label if you want it in. Docs-only still needs a devsig approval note in the PR body (one sentence). cc @sam for QA gating.

sam: I can approve devsig short-circuit for true docs-only. Also can run a quick smoke after merge. @release-bot can you confirm staging window?

release-bot: AUTO — freeze scheduled at 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z for release v1.5.2. Late-merge form: https://go/release-exceptions. Exceptions require: 1) form filled, 2) release manager ack, 3) QA sign-off, 4) a green CI run.

oliver: @maria if it's only CHANGELOG.md + version bump (no build outputs changed) tag it `docs-only` and paste the PR link here. If any build artifact or dependency changed, we can't accept it after freeze.

maria: tagging now. PR: https://git.redwood/PR/6289 — added `docs-only` label and short devsig note.

aj: in case people need the cherry-pick commands, here's what worked for me earlier:
```
# cherry-pick into release branch
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/cherry-pr-6289 origin/release
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
# push and open PR against release
git push origin release/cherry-pr-6289
```

kevin: reminder — canary validation window is 30m post-merge. If smoke fails we'll revert immediately. Keep the rollback handy.

sam: I'll run the smoke script after merge: `./scripts/smoke-release.sh --env staging` and report back.

ci-bot: CI — PR 6289: re-run requested by aj. Current status: queued (expected 12m).

oliver: final note — any exceptions must have release manager ack + QA sign-off by T-30m. I'll triage approvals in this thread, leave a short rationale in the form. :eyes:

maria: acked and filing the form now, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
